[[File:BeattheCock!-GTASA-poster.png|thumb|right|Beat the Cock! poster]]
'''Beat The Cock!''' is the name of two triathlon events in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]].
:These events are unlocked after completing [[Yay_Ka-Boom-Boom|Yay Ka-Boom-Boom]], and are only available on [[Days_of_the_Week|weekends]].

== Description ==
The triathlon consists of swimming, running, and cycling. The triathlon is notable for having a man dressed in the [[Cluckin' Bell]] suit to take part of the event. Both triathlons take place on only on Saturdays and Sundays, and is available after "[[Yay Ka-Boom-Boom]]." The player must have more than half cycling skill and more than half stamina in order to take part. The first Beat the Cock challenge is located in [[Santa Maria Beach]], [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]]. The other is at [[Fisher's Lagoon]], [[Red County]]. [[Carl Johnson]] needs to come in first in order to beat the event. By competing in the event, Carl is automatically given [[Pro-Laps]] 'Ball Shorts' to wear. The reward for completing the event is $10,000.

The triathlon at Santa Maria Beach starts with swimming across the [[Los Santos Inlet]] to [[Flint County]]. The next phase is to cycle towards the [[Avispa Country Club]], through Flint County's woods. The last phase ends with a sprint to the top of [[Missionary Hill]].

At the Fisher's Lagoon triathlon, the player first must swim the 9 checkpoints, then bike an extremely long course (approximately 13 minutes), ending with a sprint on Las Venturas' [[The Strip]]. The course takes you through [[Hilltop Farm]], [[Blueberry]], into [[San Fierro]] and [[Tierra Robada]] and finally into [[Las Venturas]]. The reward for this grueling triathlon is $20,000.

Whereas in some automotive racing challenges when the player could shoot the opponent and get away with it, shooting the opponents while racing in this race will result in an instant disqualification, as well as not getting on the bike within the 25 second limit during the cycling phase.

Completion of the [[Burglary]] side-mission will help the player immensely, as the infinite sprint is almost crucial in winning.

The name of this event is an obvious reference to masturbation.
